text:
Maria Gomez: Heads-up — Deploybot scheduled a maintenance window tonight 22:00 UTC to pin runtime image + rotate GPU drivers on dedicated pools. Need final statuspage copy and customer email snippet. :warning:
Sam Lee: got it. what's the rollback criteria?
Ajay Patel: rollback if tail latency > 200ms p95 for >5m or if error rate spike >1%. We'll set canary to 10% traffic first.
Priya Nair: ops checklist please — I can draft the statuspage + email once we confirm timeline and rollback triggers.
Maria Gomez: timeline: 22:00 start, 22:00-22:20 canary (10% dedicated), 22:20-23:30 staged ramp. Target end by 00:00 UTC.
Claire (support): please include the customer-facing brief with expected impact: short blip possible for dedicated customers during pin. Also include contact link and severity mapping.
deploybot: [deploybot] Scheduled job created: `job/rotate-gpu-drivers-2026-03-21` starting 4356789123. Canary nodes: ded-pool-eu-1 subset-2.
ops-bot: preflight checks: GPU drivers compatible on 98% of nodes, KV-cache warm = ok, active sessions < threshold.
Sam Lee: copy for statuspage (short snippet) draft below — pls iterate: 
```
Scheduled maintenance: GPU driver pin and runtime image rotation in dedicated pools starting 22:00 UTC on 2026-03-21. We expect brief request slowdowns for affected dedicated customers during canary and staged rollout. No data change. Engineers will monitor performance and rollback if errors or latency regressions are detected.
```
Priya Nair: customer email subject suggestions: "Planned maintenance — Dedicated GPU runtime update (Mar 21, 22:00 UTC)" or "Upcoming maintenance: brief performance impact possible"
Claire (support): Also include a one-line CI why: "This update ensures driver compatibility and reduces future restarts." Keep it simple.
Ajay Patel: internal runbook snippet (short): 
```
- Kickoff at 22:00 UTC, confirm canary subset
- Monitor p95 latency, error rate, GPU temps
- If p95 >200ms for 5m or errors >1% -> PAUSE and trigger rollback
- Rollback command: `/deploybot rollback job/rotate-gpu-drivers-2026-03-21 --target canary`
- Post-rollback: open incident channel, notify support, draft customer follow-up
```
Maria Gomez: can someone own the customer-facing post on status.redwood.ai?
Claire (support): I'll publish and pin. Draft statuspage copy I'm proposing: 
```
Title: Scheduled maintenance — Dedicated GPU runtime update
Body: We will perform a routine update to GPU drivers and runtime images in dedicated pools starting 22:00 UTC on 2026-03-21. You may see short periods of increased latency for affected workloads while we validate canary and roll out changes. We do not expect service interruption for hosted API users. If we detect regressions, we will pause the rollout and restore the previous image. Estimated completion: 00:00 UTC.
Updates will be posted here and via email.
```
Sam Lee: add a short customer-facing FAQ line: "Who is impacted?" -> "Customers using Dedicated GPU pools in EU/US regions; Hosted API unaffected."
Priya Nair: final email body (short): 
```
Subject: Planned maintenance — Dedicated GPU runtime update (Mar 21, 22:00 UTC)
Hi —
We will perform a routine update to GPU drivers and runtime images in Dedicated GPU pools starting 22:00 UTC on Mar 21. You may experience brief latency increases for affected workloads while we validate the update. No action is required on your side. If you rely on pinned versions, your pinned instances will be unaffected unless you opt into this update.
We will post updates to https://status.redwood.ai and notify if any rollback is required.
Thanks, Redwood Inference Ops
```
Maria Gomez: tagging owners: @Sam Lee (runtime lead) will monitor metrics; @Ajay Patel will approve rollback; @Claire (support) publishes status + sends email.
Ajay Patel: I will be on-call during the window. If we hit rollback, plan to run full rollback then a hotfix for nodes that failed the canary.
Sam Lee: quick check — set automated rollback threshold in deploybot to p95 200ms and errors 1%. deploybot command ready: 
```
/deploybot schedule job/rotate-gpu-drivers-2026-03-21 --start 2026-03-21T22:00Z --canary 10% --rollback-threshold "p95>200ms,errors>1%"
```
Priya Nair: I'll prepare the email blast template and a short pin to send 1 hour prior. Claire, want me to hand it to you for send?
Claire (support): yes please. I'll do the send at 21:00 UTC and post the status update at kickoff. I'll also watch ops channel.
Maria Gomez: final note — include the pinned model/runtime version numbers in the post-mortem and the customer follow-up. Also add a line about how to contact support during the window (support@redwood.ai + live chat).
Sam Lee: acknowledged. I'll make sure metrics alerts are wired to the oncall and to #eng-oncall.
Claire (support): publishing plan and will paste the statuspage URL here after posting.
Maria Gomez: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene here if anything abnormal. :white_check_mark:
